If useful devices cost Cnew=(P+Fnew)/Ynew and Cold=(P+Fold)/Yold, where P is a genuinely common port/package/test allowance, F is the differing process allowance and Y the actual working fraction, tenfold cost reduction requires

The useful operation remains atmospheric air at 425 ppm CO2, oxygen present, 20--30 C and 20--40% RH to >=95% dry CO2 at 1 bar, >=50% admitted-stream removal, >=1 kg/day over 100 h, <=0.50 kWh purchased energy/kg and <=2 kg charged water/kg including preparation and startup. 2. The outer gas/water barrier is not the inner ionic separator
A gas-permeable covering of a wet capture interface sees only tens of pascals of atmospheric CO2 driving pressure, but thousands of pascals of water-vapor driving pressure. A separate carbon-pump membrane can see nearly one bar of CO2 backpressure. These different functions cannot be assigned the same favorable permeability without a real architecture.
